description: Incorporate the full v15 genomics workbook and every existing and planned legacy feature into an independently installable Dapane successor.
external_dependencies: Authorised access to the hash-pinned original v15 workbook and the sources required by the legacy scenarios.
Pinned legacy provider sources, retained revisions, feature plans and compatibility artefacts for baseline and recovery.

verification.scope: Full source-linked workbook and feature coverage, an installed successor independent of the legacy checkout, and reproduction and recovery evidence.
commands: Compare the workbook digest and run historical_library_preparation_request and dapane.evaluate in the installed CPython 3.15.1 comparator.
